docs.summary: Central registry for named, rebindable keyboard shortcuts. Shortcuts are registered at startup and checked each frame via [`IsPressed`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Core.ShortcutManager~IsPressed). User overrides are persisted in [`ShortcutOverrides`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Theming.EditorSettings~ShortcutOverrides).
The category of shortcuts that fire anywhere in the editor.
Goes up whenever a binding changes, so anything built from the bindings knows to rebuild.

docs.summary: Register a shortcut with a default binding.

Returns true if the shortcut was triggered this frame. Checks [`GetKeyDown`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Input~GetKeyDown) for the primary key and enforces exact modifier state. On macOS the "Ctrl" modifier is interpreted as Cmd (Super) so platform-native shortcuts like Cmd+S work without rebinding.

Like [`IsPressed`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Core.ShortcutManager~IsPressed), but also hides the key from gameplay until it's released. Shortcuts run in the GUI, after gameplay has updated, so without this the game reads the same press next frame.
Get the effective binding for a shortcut.
